name: 1social-linkedin
description: A LinkedIn posting workflow for the 1Social connector: turn an idea, notes or an article into a LinkedIn post with a strong opening, attach images, check it against LinkedIn's limits, then publish now or schedule it.

interface.longDescription:
Write and publish LinkedIn posts without leaving the chat. Share an idea, rough notes, a launch or an article, and get a post written for LinkedIn: an opening that earns the "see more" click, short readable paragraphs and a clear point, in your own voice. Add images, check the post against LinkedIn's limits before anything goes out, then publish it now or schedule it up to 30 days ahead in your own timezone.

After publishing you get a receipt that says whether the post actually landed, with a link to it. Anything still scheduled can be edited or cancelled from the chat.

Requires the 1Social connector ("Instagram & TikTok by 1Social"): add it in one tap at https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a6eeddc84a08191af3e632007e03ba3 and sign in. You also need a LinkedIn account connected to your 1Social account.
defaultPrompt: Write a LinkedIn post about what we learned launching our product and publish it.
Turn these notes into a LinkedIn post and schedule it for Tuesday at 9am.
Make this article into a LinkedIn post with a strong first line.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: guided LinkedIn posting and scheduling over the 1Social connector.
